text:
Ava: Heads up — AuroraCompute signed off on a joint perf/W + throughput study. Goal: quantify perf/W across kernel variants and sustained throughput at p95/p99. Need alignment on workloads, telemetry tags, and runbook ownership. Who can lead the runbook?
Miguel: I can own load profiles and prompt sets. Planning to include a mix: chat-like long-context (2048) + streaming short requests. Also will prepare a quantization matrix to test.
Sanya: I’ll own kernel variants and the build artifacts. Need the exact HW SKUs and the OS image to reproduce locally. Also request read-only access to the telemetry agent.
Nate (Aurora): We can provide two SKUs: AC-6800-v2 and AC-6800-v2-lowpower. Image: `aurora-ubuntu-22.04-inf`. We’ll provision a telemetry token scoped to `runtime_agent:read` and the external PDU CSV access. ETA to provision: Tue EOD.
Ava: Proposed schedule: dry-run this Fri (small sweep), full sweep Mon–Wed next week. Runbook draft here: https://docs.redwood.dev/private/aurora-joint-runbook (internal).
Miguel: Quick question — how are we measuring perf/W? On-board PMIC or external PDUs? Need to standardize and add sync markers so we can correlate traces.
Nate (Aurora): We recommend external PDU for absolute power numbers; we’ll also publish PMIC readings. We’ll attach PDU CSVs and include `--pdu-sync` ticks in the runner so you can match telemetry.
Sanya: Please ensure nodes have NTP sync and `hwclock -s` before runs. Kernel to pin: `5.19.17-rc2-patch-kv` for parity across sites. I’ll post build artifacts to the runbook release folder.
Ava: Run snippet added to runbook — use this command template for reproducibility:
```
./bench_runner \
  --model redwood-13b \
  --seq 2048 \
  --clients 8 \
  --duration 1200 \
  --run-id ${RUN_ID} \
  --telemetry-tag=aurora-ac-v2 \
  --pdu-sync
```
bench-ci-bot: CI job created for dry-run: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/8392 (dry-run).
Nate (Aurora): Heads-up: legal wants a 72h embargo after data handoff for joint press language. Is that acceptable?
Ava: That’s fine — we’ll schedule an internal data review 48h after handoff to prep talking points. @Miguel @Sanya please note embargo window.
Miguel: :thumbsup:
Sanya: Queuing kernel builds tonight and will upload artifacts to the runbook folder when done.
Ava: Next sync Wed 10:00 PT. If any blockers pop up, ping me or drop notes in this thread. Thanks everyone :rocket:
